import unittest

from solution import compile_routes


class CompileRoutesTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_normalization_order_and_immutability(self):
        specs = [["", "root"], ["api//v1", "one"], ["/users/", "two"]]
        result = compile_routes(iter(specs))
        self.assertEqual(result, (("/", "root"), ("/api/v1/", "one"), ("/users/", "two")))
        self.assertIsInstance(result, tuple)
        self.assertTrue(all(isinstance(item, tuple) for item in result))
        specs[1][0] = "changed"
        self.assertEqual(result[1], ("/api/v1/", "one"))

    def test_empty_and_duplicates(self):
        self.assertEqual(compile_routes([]), ())
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            compile_routes([("a//b", "x"), ("/a/b/", "y")])

    def test_malformed_inputs(self):
        for outer in (None, 4, "abc", b"abc"):
            with self.assertRaises(TypeError): compile_routes(outer)
        for specs in ([["only"]], [["a", "h", "extra"]], [3]):
            with self.assertRaises(TypeError): compile_routes(specs)
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError): compile_routes([(1, "h")])
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError): compile_routes([("a", None)])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError): compile_routes([("a", "")])
        for path in ("/a?x=1", "/a#part", "/a/./b", "/a/../b"):
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError): compile_routes([(path, "h")])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
